summary: Created on a fresh entity by ecl::GameStateLoadSession::Enter (bg3.exe+0x1BBDF50): a copy of the eoc::LoadSessionDesc of the load (+0x00..+0x80) and a pointer back to the game state (+0x80). Exists only while a session is loading.

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xF19B50 copies 4 bytes from the source variant: int (tag 1), float (2), FixedString with IncRef (3), one byte (4, bool); the value destructor bg3.exe+0x5EE7E0 releases a FixedString at +0 when the tag is 3.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: Variant tag at +4 (bg3.exe+0x5EE7E0 / 0xF19B50: 0 none, 1 int, 2 float, 3 FixedString, 4 bool); values stride 8 (FUN_1405ee7e0 loop step 8).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xF19960 (LoadSessionDesc ctor) writes 0; copied by bg3.exe+0x1BBE010; EoCShared.dll eoc::LoadSessionDesc::Visit sends it as a uint32 first.

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: ctor writes 0xFFFFFFFF; released by the component destructor bg3.exe+0x5F1BB0 (+4); Visit sends a FixedString.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: ctor stores the global FixedString DAT_14617662c (IncRef); released by the destructor; Visit sends it with VisitGUID (a GUID-string FixedString).

fields.name: _PadC
fields.evidence: not written by the ctor F19960 nor copied by bg3.exe+0x1BBE010 / the Toolkit move ctor: padding before the array at +0x10

fields.name: Rulesets
fields.evidence: ctor zeroes 16 bytes; destructor clears and frees an array at +0x10 (FUN_1405bd630 + Free); Toolkit Visit walks it with stride 0x10 visiting Guids. Name from Script Extender's eoc::ruleset::RulesetComponent, which pairs Array<Guid> Rulesets with the same modifier map.

fields.name: RulesetModifiers
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xF19B50 builds a hash map at +0x20 from 0x18-byte (Guid + variant) source records: 16-byte keys, 8-byte values at +0x50 (alloc count*8); destructor: value dtor bg3.exe+0x5EE7E0 + Free(+0x50) + key-set dtor FUN_140582AD0(+0x20). Toolkit Visit names the type HashMap<ls::Guid, ls::Variant<eoc::ruleset::NoneValue,int,float,FixedString,bool>> (ruleset::Visit).

fields.name: field_60
fields.evidence: ctor stores DAT_14617662c; destructor releases +0x60; Visit sends it with VisitGUID.

fields.name: field_68
fields.evidence: ctor zeroes; bg3.exe+0x1BBE010 copies 8 bytes; no destructor. Not in the Toolkit's 0x68-byte LoadSessionDesc (build difference).

fields.name: GameState
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1BBE1E0 zeroes +0x80; bg3.exe+0x1BBDF50 (GameStateLoadSession enter) stores its own this pointer here after copying the desc from this+0x28.

open_questions: Names of field_0 / field_4 / field_8 / field_60 (the desc has no named accessors).
+0x68..+0x80: three 8-byte values copied as such; type unknown (could be a Guid + 8 bytes).
Array element type Guid comes from the Toolkit Visit (stride 0x10); the game destructor shows only a trivially destructible array.
